ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, AB is the diameter of the circle $O$, and point C is on the circle. If $\angle ABC = 70^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BAC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AB$ is the diameter of circle $O$,\\
it follows that $\angle C=90^\circ$,\\
since $\angle ABC=70^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BAC=90^\circ-70^\circ=\boxed{20^\circ}$.
